verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never states that customer data is excluded from AI model training, and it documents no training opt-out. What it does document is a Zero Data Retention policy that auto-deletes API data within 24 hours on Growth tier and above, plus VPC deployment options. Those are retention and deployment controls, which are related to but different from a no-training guarantee, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
